source: Roland TR-909 service notes, 1st ed. (15 Jun 1984): the boards' foil views, p.9 (switch board), p.10 (voicing board), p.12 (multi-jack, DIN jack and power supply boards), 1:1 at 400 dpi
frame: panel mm (docs/panel.json): x from the left side as seen from the front, y from the rear edge of the top panel. The boards are seen from below (the foil side), so the service view mirrors x.
levels: 0 is nearest the top panel; from below, a higher level hides a lower one: the switch board under the keys, the voicing board below it on the pots, the jack boards at the rear panel, the power supply on the base

placement.voicing: affine fit of its 27 small pots (mounting slots) to the knob centres: 0.15 mm rms
placement.switch: 1:1 mirrored, the step keys' 23.0 mm pitch, SW4 on step key 4
placement.multijack: x fitted to the twelve rear jacks (0.34 mm rms), its rear edge at the rear panel
placement.dinjack: x fitted to its four DIN sockets and four jacks (0.44 mm rms), its rear edge at the rear panel
placement.power: assumed: in front of the transformer, which stands in the voicing board's cut-out at the rear left, by the POWER switch and AC inlet
placement.transformer: assumed: in the voicing board's cut-out

pad_kinds: 0 round, 1 oval along x (page), 2 oval along y, 3 a jumper wire's pad (drawn dark)
